patches_modified.name: Clean main UI
patches_modified.description: Hides the bottom navigation bar, the top-right guide icon, and the Rate/Help/About drawer items, and brings the connect/create/join buttons to front. Reapplied on create, resume, and drawer open (and retried for ~1.8s after each) since some of these views are inflated lazily.

patches_removed.name: Disable downloader from download menu
patches_removed.description: Strips RsDownloadActivity's file-extension and scheme/mimeType intent filters so it no longer offers itself as a handler in the system download/"complete action using" chooser.

patches_removed.name: Disable downloader from download menu
patches_removed.description: Strips WebDownloadActivity's scheme/mimeType/host/pathPattern intent-filter data (action and category tags kept) so it no longer offers itself as a handler in the system download/"complete action using" chooser.

patches_added.name: Exclude Google Play apps from update checks
patches_added.description: Excludes only apps whose recorded Android installer is Google Play from update requests.

patches_added.name: Restore secure-session compatibility
patches_added.description: Adapts secure-session requests to RuStore 1.108 API changes for re-signed APKs.

patches_added.name: Restrict background work to updates
patches_added.description: Keeps only the background workers required for automatic update checks, downloads, patch application, and installation, including charging-triggered checks.

patches_modified.name: Disable advertisements
patches_modified.description: Removes ad providers, sanitizes ad identifiers, returns an empty ad list, and keeps advertising consent disabled.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics and trackers
patches_modified.description: Disables audited analytics transports and replaces the stable request device identifier.

patches_modified.name: Disable Friend Lists ad
patches_modified.description: Disables the friend tab BizBoard and global-region ads in KakaoTalk.

patches_modified.name: Disable chat room list ad
patches_modified.description: Disables native and global-region ads in the chat room list.
